verdict.rationale: Appwrite is explicitly designed for self-hosting via Docker (any OS with Docker CLI, one-click marketplace installs), and the official CLI can manage projects/functions against a self-hosted instance, which together let a developer run the whole backend locally before deploying to cloud. However, there's no dedicated 'emulator' concept (unlike Firebase-style local emulation) and no hands-on evidence of the full docker-compose local stack actually working end-to-end. missing for 10: dedicated local emulator/offline-testing tooling, hands-on verification of the full self-hosted docker stack running locally, and clear pre-deploy parity guarantees between local and cloud.
